hook.name: Process
hook.description: A self-contained ERC-20 token and Uniswap v4 hook for the PROCESS/native ETH pool. Charges a fixed 1% fee on both buys and sells (always in PROCESS), distributes 100% of fees to eligible token holders via an O(1) accumulator-based reward index, and tracks a gamified "Skull Process" integrity counter that advances or retreats with qualifying swaps.
